title: At the Iron Gate  (Junto a la verja de hierro)

segments.t: Afuera, bajo la sombra del árbol en la posada Linden Courtyard Inn, en Portland, el hermano mayor, Owen, permanece erguido con su abrigo gris frente a Caleb mientras Hannah deja una tetera caliente y se retira un paso. Escucha primero toda la escena.
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
Ahora repasemos la conversación con calma, frase por frase.
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
'Así que "alguien con algo del abuelo" eras tú todo el tiempo, Caleb.'
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
'Hola, Owen. Gracias por venir hoy.'
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
'Reconocí tu letra limpia de imprenta en esa postal en dos segundos.'
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
'Espera, ¿sabías que era mía y viniste de todos modos?'
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
'Por supuesto que vine. ¿Por qué te escondiste detrás de una nota misteriosa?'
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
'Porque tenía miedo de que siguieras enfadado. Te eché de menos estos tres años.'
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
'Tres años cabezotas... sinceramente, hermanito, yo también te eché de menos.'
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
'Disculpen, caballeros. Aquí tienen té caliente, y el pastel tibio de limón viene de camino.'
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
'¿Pastel de limón? Espera, ¿cómo sabía ella lo del pastel de limón de los viernes?'
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
'Siéntate, Owen, quítate tu abrigo pesado y mira esta maleta azul.'
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
'¿Esa es la vieja bolsa azul oscuro del taller del abuelo?'
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
'Tómense todo el tiempo que necesiten. El patio es suyo.'
Escuchemos otra vez toda la escena a velocidad natural.
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
Owen reconoció la letra de Caleb en dos segundos y vino de todos modos. En la próxima escena abren el paquete de papel blanco bajo el árbol del patio. Hasta la próxima.
See you soon!
